title: The Silent Bell
content: They say there's an old bell somewhere beneath the town. Sometimes people hear it ring, even when nobody has touched it. Those who hear it swear the streets look different afterward.

title: The Merchant's Missing Fortune
content: A wealthy merchant buried a chest of gold outside the eastern road before disappearing. His servants have been searching for it ever since, but nobody knows where he buried it.

title: The Bride in the Woods
content: A traveler claims he saw a woman dressed in an old wedding gown standing between the trees. When he approached, she vanished. He says he heard a bell just before she disappeared.

title: The Rat King
content: There's a giant rat living beneath the bakery. It wears a little crown and commands the others. The baker swears it's true, though he's been drinking rather heavily lately.

title: The Empty Graves
content: Some of the graves in the old cemetery are empty. Not robbed, not disturbed. Empty. The gravedigger refuses to work after sunset now.

title: The Watchman's Bribe
content: Certain wagons pass through the caravan yard without inspection. Everyone knows someone in the watch is being paid, but nobody agrees on who.

title: The Forgotten Heir
content: The old noble family has a hidden heir living among commoners. They say the child bears a birthmark shaped like the family's crest, and someone has been quietly searching for them.
source: A servant from a noble household

title: The Cursed Blacksmith
content: A blacksmith once forged a blade for a wealthy family and was cursed for it. Now every weapon he touches breaks, and his reflection sometimes moves when he doesn't.

title: The Secret Tunnel
content: There's a tunnel beneath the town hall leading straight to the treasury. A drunk mason claims he helped build it and still remembers the entrance. Nobody believes him.

title: The Forest That Moves
content: Travelers returning from the forest say the paths don't always lead where they should. One man claims he walked east for an entire day and somehow returned to the same clearing.

title: The Stolen Moonstone
content: A local jeweler's most valuable moonstone was stolen last week. The strange part is that the thief left behind a perfectly identical stone, except it casts no shadow.

title: The Three Faiths
content: The three religious institutions have been arguing over who has the right to ring the ceremonial bell during the next public gathering. Some say the disagreement is about more than tradition.

title: The Invisible Pickpocket
content: A thief has been stealing purses without ever touching anyone. People swear their coins simply vanish while they're walking through the market. It's probably a wizard. Or a very talented monkey.

title: The Prisoner's Warning
content: A prisoner recently escaped the guardhouse, leaving a message scratched into the wall: 'Don't trust the faces beneath the masks.' The guards painted over it before anyone could investigate.

title: The Merchant's Good Deed
content: A wealthy merchant has been secretly paying the debts of struggling families. Some call it charity. Others insist he's buying their loyalty before a major political decision.
